name: Andrew Losee Lamoreaux
bioAdditions: A. J. Lamoureux's Lamoureux Record (1919) says Joshua Lamoureux, youngest son of Daniel, married Elizabeth Ogden (b. 1738) in Dutchess Co., lived for a time in New Brunswick and then settled near Scarborough, York Co., Upper Canada. It says 'the Utah branch' descends from him through 'Andrew Lacy and David Burlock Lamoreaux who went to that territory with Brigham Young' (S1). This supports the site's line through Joshua. The 1919 author's 'Andrew Lacy' is evidently Andrew Losee Lamoreaux. Andrew died in 1855, so 'went to that territory with Brigham Young' is loose for him: he died at St. Louis on the way.

conflicts.assessment: Probably a phonetic rendering by the 1919 compiler. Keep Losee, the form in LDS records.
